{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue to numeric: remove commas and cast to float
data['revenue'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = (data['revenue'] == 999999.99)
print(f"Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}")

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_mask = (data['status'] == 'refunded')
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}")

# Apply filters: exclude QA and refunded orders
data_filtered = data[~qa_mask & ~refunded_mask].copy()

# Verify the filters worked
print(f"Remaining rows after filtering: {len(data_filtered)}")

# Now check the original finding about customer_age
print(f"Number of customer_age == -1: {(data['customer_age'] == -1).sum()}")

# Check the distribution of channels and segments
print("\nChannel distribution:")
print(data_filtered['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nCustomer segment distribution by channel:")
print(pd.crosstab(data_filtered['channel'], data_filtered['customer_segment']))

# Check conversion rates by channel
conv_rates = data_filtered.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(conv_rates)

# Raw difference
raw_diff = conv_rates['email'] - conv_rates['paid_search']
print(f"\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff}")"}
